rules: 118.2 and601.2g: activated mana abilities are available in mana payment windows.
601.2f/h and602.2b: the locked complete payment cannot become a partial payment; existing guided API preserves a completion at each own decision.
605.3b: an activated mana ability completes immediately, including post-cost entry/color choices, before its enclosing payment resumes.

source_contract: TreasureAbility pays tap and sacrifice before AddManaOfAnyColorEffect chooses its color; ActivatedManaAbilityImpl usesStack=false. Oracle Draconautics requires the already locked red activation cost. XMage net-mana previews are not evidence that every later color preserves this library's mandatory guided payment contract.

boundaries.change: One visitor is shared by offered raw/index actions and actor-only Observation.mana_choices. An owned receipt enumerates its actual post-cost domain and tests each concrete vector through the frozen parent chain or guided terminal. Ordinary resolving AddMana has no receipt and retains its whole domain.

Any receipt, including a selected nonzero dynamic preview, is evaluated in each projected post-cost entry world. Captured output quality, original controller, exact source departure power and frozen tap bonus are used once; child costs are not replayed.

Direct borrowed BF/GY mana actions reuse existing viable-plan preparation. Announced mana PayCosts enumerates exact physical allocations through the same frozen child completion, retaining complete viable plans for later scalar lot choices.

Only announced fixed mana without an enclosing announcement and with a nonPriority pending window receives an existing cold receipt. It retains Plot/FaceUp/Attack/optional Resolution resume; ordinary fixed direct/priority paths remain unchanged. Legacy announcement_quality is not simultaneously captured for a new receipt.

negative_contracts: Foreign entry choices may already have stranded a parent. When foreign_cast_choice_pending and an owned cast_rollback capture exist, the paid child keeps its whole legitimate output domain, then existing concrete replay/rollback proceeds.
Priority mana, ordinary resolving AddMana and top-level optional ResolutionMana with Decline retain every legitimate color/allocation. Nested real announcements still owe their own costs.
FaceUp and Attack retain existing abort/rollback contracts; no new general checkpoint or rollback representation.
An exact Plot subject must still be the same owned card in hand; projected resources and memo identity retain that otherwise inert object.
No Game clones or powerset enumeration. Output domains and provenance allocations use existing bounded visitors and FundingState queries; fixed direct fast paths do not allocate receipts.
